# Myelektra

> AI-Powered Revenue Growth Partner for B2B companies. We build revenue systems, not just lead lists.

## What We Do

Myelektra helps B2B companies move from scattered prospecting to structured, measurable revenue systems. We identify the right buyers, start meaningful sales conversations, manage opportunities in HubSpot, and build predictable revenue pipelines.

## Solutions

- Revenue Intelligence: Market-entry and prospecting foundation
- Pipeline Builder: Turn buyer personas into qualified conversations
- Revenue Engine: Integrated revenue system with forecasting
- AI Sales Transformation: Automate and scale manual sales activities
- Fractional Revenue Office: Revenue leadership and RevOps support

## Industries

SaaS, Manufacturing, Professional Services, Technology, B2B companies
